encode_audio_example: encode an audio example from a path, bytes, or dict into a PyArrow-compatible dictionary format
decode_audio_example: decode an audio file from a path or bytes into a torchcodec AudioDecoder object with configurable sampling rate
cast_audio_storage: cast a PyArrow string, binary, or struct array into the Audio feature struct storage type
embed_audio_storage: embed local or remote audio file bytes into a PyArrow struct array for dataset storage
encode_torchcodec_audio: encode a torchcodec AudioDecoder object into a WAV bytes dictionary for PyArrow storage
